checker: participant-side human review assisted by local browser and PDF rendering

checks.method: human inspection of HTML img elements against figure meaning
checks.evidence: content-specific alt text is present for core figures and synthetic scenes

checks.method: Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter review of interactive delivery-contract buttons; static report requires no pointer-only action
checks.evidence: native buttons are reachable and activatable; focus follows document order

checks.method: human DOM-order inspection at desktop and 390 px mobile width
checks.evidence: header, main sections, headings, figures, notes and footer retain logical order without horizontal overflow

checks.method: human inspection of all core figures
checks.evidence: IDs, labels, shapes, headers and stop/status text accompany palette encoding

checks.method: desktop and 390 px viewport render inspection
checks.evidence: no overlap, clipping, missing image or horizontal overflow in bilingual pages

checks.method: render every bilingual page and compare sequence, blank pages and cropping
checks.evidence: paired sequence retained; no blank or cropped pages

checks.item: PDF semantic tagging and selectable reading order
checks.evidence: image-based board/booklet PDFs are visual presentation copies; Markdown and offline HTML are the accessible text alternatives
checks.required_before_accessible_publication: produce tagged PDFs with language, headings, alternative text, reading order, bookmarks and independent assistive-technology QA

field_co_test_plan.minimum: 12 consented route tasks across at least 3 access-need groups plus 2 independent professional reviewer types
ethics: no service entitlement exchanged for participation
avoid recording identity or diagnosis unless separately necessary and authorised
field_co_test_plan.record: de-identified segment, barrier, task outcome, assistance, correction owner/date and withdrawal flag
field_co_test_plan.stop_and_exit: pause on continuous-route, alternative-information, keyboard-access or human-fallback failure; correct, retest, sign off, or close and reinstate

limits: Participant-side QA is not a WCAG, PDF/UA, legal accessibility, assistive-technology, or field-access certification.
